loading_messages: Zombies spawn based on a 1 to 100 difficulty chance. This increases over time, but can be adjusted in the settings.
Zombies drop various items such as iron ingots, iron nuggets, gold ingots, gold nuggets, copper, gunpowder, ender pearls, phantom membranes, redstone, and netherite scraps.
You can equip a torch in offhand by using it.
Rotten flesh can be cooked into raw flesh, then into cooked flesh, and finally into leather.
Ender zombies teleport, Witch zombies use potions, Jumpers can leap, Miners break blocks, and Giants only spawn during hordes.
Using swords allows sweeping damage against multiple enemies.
Every 8 days, zombie movement speed increases.
Hordes spawn randomly and are very dangerous.
Zombie armor and weapons improve as difficulty increases.
Light makes you more visible. Taking damage allows zombies to smell and track you.
This is a one man project, so if you want to support the creator, visit §cRanzie §fon YouTube
Lower max day setting causes faster zombie mutation.
The longer you play, the stronger they become!
Horde events set the spawnrate of zombies to 100 percent
